The skills acquired in this lab class are crucial for bioinformatic tasks using molecular data, such as data analysis, scripting,
and working in high-performance computing (HPC) environments. My hope is that you don’t just type the commands into the terminal and
move on -- I would like you to ***think*** about what these commands are doing and start imagining how they could be useful in analyzing your own data.

Each lab is inteded to be a reference point for you on various bioinformatic tasks.
To make the most of these labs, please treat them like a **personal resource**, so
adjust any specific commands accordingly.

### Overview of today's lab
This lab provides a reference point for working with GitHub. There will be a recording of how to prepare the
repository for this lab and we will go through this again as we write our own codes to document our progress on the
lab's projects.

This ***guided-lab entry*** is for you to build and work with. I have provided the bones, but
you should spend today's lab updating, checking the changes, and uploading to GitHub when you are happy.
The more work you put here early, the more comfortable it will be!

As this particular lab page, represent *your* notes, please put as much or as little as you want. I cannot
stress it enough, that you are in charge of this and you should ***not*** be asking others for help each
week for updating your notebook. I expect it the first couple weeks, but your notes here will help prevent that!

I strongly suggest asking questions today while the exercise is fresh in your mind (and while your classmates are around to help you!).
